name: Slosson
bio: Slosson was a billiards player whose matches the Cow Boy followed in its sporting notes, reporting in June 1884 that he beat the champion Schaefer at balk-line in Chicago. In December 1885 he finished third behind Schaefer and Vignaux in a series for the world billiard championship.
